title: Area 51 equipment acquired from other governments

tellings.quote: equipment in Area 51 because there is equipment there that we acquired from other governments.

plain: There is equipment at Area 51, the secret US test site in Nevada, that the United States got from other governments, according to John S. Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy. He said this himself in an interview with Michels, which suggests the base studies foreign hardware as well as American aircraft.
